import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def power(base, exponent):
    return pow(base, exponent, MOD)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])

    if K == 0:
        print(power(p, p - 1))
        return
    if K == 1:
        print(power(p, p))
        return

    visited = [False] * p
    comp = 0

    for i in range(p):
        if visited[i]:
            continue
        size = 0
        cur = i
        while True:
            if visited[cur]:
                break
            size += 1
            visited[cur] = True
            cur = (cur * K) % p
        if size > 1:
            comp += 1

    print(power(p, comp))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
